findings.title: priced-line arithmetic is not closed by qty × unit price
findings.numeric_evidence: 17 of 1572 priced lines diverge; net signed delta -8,759,173 USD, absolute 9,093,071 USD. Largest: AZNS-207 Procurement for AZNS- F-20 expected 3,585,579 vs total 0 (-100.0%); AZNS-40 Rig Service expected 2,346,000 vs total 819,820 (-65.1%); AZNS-75 Contingency 3 expected 1,240,918 vs total 0 (-100.0%); AZNS-75 Contingency 4 expected 892,716 vs total 0 (-100.0%); AZNS-75 Contingency 5 expected 571,588 vs total 0 (-100.0%)
findings.interpretation: The CBS Total column is a lump-sum/allocated ceiling, not always the algebraic product of QTY and Unit Price. Treating both as identical would misstate the invoice basis.
findings.action: Keep both columns with their source cell, close out each line contractually before payment, and never recompute the ceiling from QTY × price.

findings.title: 24-h narrative logs contain carried-over / overlapping rows from adjacent reports
findings.numeric_evidence: After selecting the single canonical sheet per report and removing blank summary rows: 16 of 1252 days under-coded, 1224 over-coded; mean signed gap -5.77 h/day, total carried-over excess 7,393 h (mean 5.90 h/day), genuine under-coded shortfall 163 h.
findings.interpretation: DDR operation logs frequently include a continuation row from the previous or next midnight. The excess is flagged as carried-over hours; it is never silently redistributed into PT or NPT, and the source rows are retained.
findings.action: Introduce a report-boundary timestamp on every activity row at DDR capture, then recompute ILT; investigate the largest carried-over days individually.

findings.title: Cumulative depth / 24-h footage typographical errors are isolated
findings.numeric_evidence: 3 of 1304 daily rows show |drilled_24 − (MD24−MD00)| > 25 m; total absolute mismatch 1,799.8 m.
findings.interpretation: Probable transcription slips in cumulative records. Correction is stored only in derived corrected_24h; the source cell is untouched.
findings.action: Use corrected_24h for time-depth analytics while keeping the source value for audit.

findings.title: Cached formula values were independently recomputed
findings.numeric_evidence: 48011 formulas evaluated: 47965 exact matches, 3 minor rounding, 43 material mismatches.
findings.interpretation: Recomputing from the archived cell values validates the Excel layer instead of trusting cached results.
findings.action: Review the mismatched cells with their sheet/cell reference before using them as invoice support.

findings.title: Unit-price dispersion across the 13 operations
findings.numeric_evidence: 36 of 267 normalised tariff keys show >5% spread. Largest: mud chemicals for 8 1⁄2" hole 63→346,938 (550,594.4%, n=8); cementing service personnel 100→3,000 (2,900.0%, n=27); completion fluids 73→1,150 (1,475.3%, n=10); contingency 3 112,511→1,240,918 (1,002.9%, n=6); coiled tubing equipment and pe 5,400→56,822 (952.3%, n=7)
findings.interpretation: Rate differences are real source values (scope, hole size, rig or contract bundle), not extraction noise; wells 29/38 remain benchmarks only.
findings.action: Benchmark each new AFE against the median of the same normalised key and flag >5% deviations.

findings.title: Well-level ROP drivers identified from paired daily rows
findings.numeric_evidence: AZNS-10 TORQUE→ROP r=0.94 (n=62, R²=0.89); AZNS-116 TORQUE→ROP r=0.91 (n=98, R²=0.82); AZNS-127-WO1-ST1 PV→ROP r=-0.85 (n=88, R²=0.73); AZNS-127-WO1-ST1 MW→ROP r=-0.69 (n=88, R²=0.48); AZNS-127-WO1-ST1 TORQUE→ROP r=0.69 (n=88, R²=0.47); AZNS-127-WO1-ST1 RPM→ROP r=0.61 (n=88, R²=0.37); AZNS-127-WO1-ST1 YP→ROP r=0.61 (n=88, R²=0.37); AZNS-40 SPP→ROP r=-0.60 (n=7, R²=0.37)
findings.interpretation: Pearson/Spearman and OLS are computed only on DDR days where both parameters exist; no missing value is imputed.
findings.action: Use the strongest per-well driver as the control variable in the next AFE parameter window.

findings.title: Prognosis-to-actual structural bias quantified across correlated tops
findings.numeric_evidence: 32 formation-well pairs with paired prognosis: 6 deeper, 2 shallower; mean signed delta 167.6 m, mean absolute 199.3 m.
findings.interpretation: A systematic bias shifts pore-pressure/fracture ramps and casing-shoe placement; a zero-mean but high absolute delta still implies a coarse structural grid.
findings.action: Update the South Azadegan structural grid with the measured tops before setting the next 9-5/8 in shoe and KOP.

findings.title: Programme prognosis vs EOWR measured tops
findings.numeric_evidence: 89 paired tops; mean signed -46.8 m, mean absolute 445.0 m, 21 deeper / 23 shallower.
findings.interpretation: Three independent top sources (Programme, EOWR, DDR) are now numerically comparable with exact file/page provenance.
findings.action: Feed measured deltas back into the next programme revision and the mud-weight window.

findings.title: Daily mud stock balance audited sequentially
findings.numeric_evidence: 2782 material-days with a source Received value; 1846 imbalance, mean absolute implied-receipt gap 5,168.8 units.
findings.interpretation: Sequential stock_prev + received − used = stock is checked instead of comparing isolated columns.
findings.action: Reconcile the largest imbalance days against the DDR back-load column before cost allocation.

findings.title: Cost efficiency ranking across the 13 operations
findings.numeric_evidence: Highest USD/day: AZNS-166 359,273; AZNS-12 144,714; AZNS-127-ST2 139,786; AZNS-127-WO2 133,095 | Lowest: AZNS-116 45,187; AZNS-127-WO1-ST1 37,297; AZNS-10 26,051; AZNS-85 23,000 | NPT share of calendar 42.6% field mean.
findings.interpretation: USD/day, USD/m (where footage exists), NPT share and payable/gross ratio expose both expensive and inefficient operations.
findings.action: Target the top-quartile USD/day wells with the NPT Pareto and the four-track deduction waterfall.

findings.title: AZNS-127 WO1 → WO2 → ST2: AZNS-127-WO1-ST1 → AZNS-127-WO2 — DEGRADED_NPT_INTENSITY
findings.numeric_evidence: NPT/day 5.50 → 13.85 h/day; CBS/day 24,370 → 125,628 USD/day; Δdays -69, ΔNPT 187.5 h, ΔCBS 5,204,034 USD.
findings.interpretation: Repeated interventions on the same wellbore are the cleanest available learning signal because geology is held approximately constant.
findings.action: Perform a formal autopsy of the degraded step before authorising another intervention.

findings.title: AZNS-127 WO1 → WO2 → ST2: AZNS-127-WO2 → AZNS-127-ST2 — IMPROVED_NPT_INTENSITY
findings.numeric_evidence: NPT/day 13.85 → 4.62 h/day; CBS/day 125,628 → 141,817 USD/day; Δdays 38, ΔNPT -452.0 h, ΔCBS 6,489,891 USD.
findings.interpretation: Repeated interventions on the same wellbore are the cleanest available learning signal because geology is held approximately constant.
findings.action: Carry the improved parameter/coding discipline forward; investigate any degradation before the next re-entry.

findings.title: AZNS-122 WO1 → WO2: AZNS-122-WO1 → AZNS-122-WO2 — IMPROVED_NPT_INTENSITY

findings.title: Top-three attributed parties concentrate most non-productive time
findings.interpretation: Attribution concentration shows whether NPT is systemic (one responsible party) or diffuse.
findings.action: Put the dominant attributed party under a joint daily NPT review with a 24-h closure target.

findings.title: Extreme numeric cells identified with z-score and provenance
findings.numeric_evidence: 900 |z|>6 cells retained, maximum |z| 18.2; full histogram by order of magnitude in an_num_hist.
findings.interpretation: Outliers are not deleted: they are usually legitimate depths, cumulative costs or casing tallies.
findings.action: Use an_outliers as a targeted QA list, not as an automatic reject rule.

findings.title: All 305,447 PDF numeric tokens classified with page/line provenance
findings.numeric_evidence: 305447 tokens / 4345 pages; 13548 unit-bearing, 28131 measurement-context, 42959 navigation, 49933 identifier, 187085 unclassified; 386692 exact Excel/fact value coincidences
findings.interpretation: Every archived PDF number now has a magnitude band, a derived context class, a robust-outlier flag and a source page/line reference. Classification is derived, never written back into the source token.
findings.action: Use AN_PDF_TOKEN rows in the dashboard and the gzip census CSV for number-by-number search; preserve raw tokens in pdf_num_pages.

findings.title: Unit-bearing numeric tokens audited by robust quartiles
findings.numeric_evidence: 13548 unit-bearing tokens across 34 unit groups; largest groups: NO_UNIT n=291,899 median=13.39 max=989,177,052,300.00; m n=3,797 median=28.00 max=3,472,117.80; psi n=2,598 median=1,000.00 max=15,000.00; 538 robust outliers
findings.interpretation: Log-magnitude IQR fences and robust z-scores separate document identifiers / page numbers from engineering values without labeling any source value an error.
findings.action: Review the top robust outliers with their page/line context before using them in engineering calculations.

findings.title: Sparse text layers remain an explicit source gap (AF-05)
findings.numeric_evidence: 364 / 4345 pages (8.38%) have <200 text characters; 2343 numeric tokens still appear on those pages; 2185 embedded images
findings.interpretation: The source-only pipeline does not OCR image-only pages. It retains each page, its image count and any text-layer numbers; it never fills missing numeric values.
findings.action: Request native/OCR versions of the flagged PDF pages before any financial close-out that depends on those table values.

findings.title: Largest derived magnitude outliers are labelled, not corrected
findings.numeric_evidence: Top examples: 1.AZNS_40_Well_Program.pdf p.229 L108 token=8,12,16,20,24,28,32, z=689.8; 7.AZNS_207_EOWR.pdf p.151 L165 token=16250 z=50.7; 1.AZNS_40_EOWR.pdf p.118 L141 token=11250 z=48.3
findings.interpretation: These tokens often represent contract numbers, dates, page headers or table-of-contents page numbers. Their derived outlier flag is an audit signal, not a source correction.
findings.action: Filter AN_PDF_OUTLIER by context_class before interpreting extreme values as engineering measurements.

findings.title: Exact six-decimal value matches between PDF, Excel and fact archives
findings.numeric_evidence: 4286 distinct PDF values (13.34%) have an exact Excel numeric-cell or EOWR-fact value match; 386692 token-level coincidences; e.g. value 1.0 PDF 22735 / Excel 12557 / fact 7; value 2.0 PDF 18158 / Excel 10379 / fact 91; value 0.0 PDF 6008 / Excel 30214 / fact 10
findings.interpretation: The comparison checks numeric equality to six decimals across the whole warehouse. It is a reconciliation lead, not proof that two different source quantities are the same physical measurement.
findings.action: Use AN_PDF_MATCH rows to trace exact values back to file/sheet/cell or page/line/table before accepting any reconciliation.

findings.title: Sourced four-track model reconciles with no 50/50 waiting fallback
findings.numeric_evidence: CBS 94,797,894.39; gross 99,843,688.22; payable 89,126,231.27; net 87,082,106.28 USD. Contractor NPT 11,183.4 h -> 10,717,456.94 USD deduction; client NPT 2,133.0 h -> 2,044,125.00 USD; all NPT 13,316.4 h -> 12,761,581.94 USD. Max per-well formula delta 0.0092 USD; 4 calendar-basis flags: AZNS-12 CBS_DAYS_GT_DDR_DAYS (CBS days 91.92 / DDR 72), AZNS-127-ST2 CBS_DAYS_GT_DDR_DAYS (CBS days 115.36 / DDR 106), AZNS-166 CBS_DAYS_GT_DDR_DAYS (CBS days 44.24 / DDR 24), AZNS-85 CBS_DAYS_MISSING (CBS days — / DDR 53). Fallback 50/50 waiting hours = 0.
findings.interpretation: gross = CBS plan + (DDR days - CBS days) x the sourced 23,000 USD/DAY rate; payable deducts contractor-attributed NPT; net deducts all attributed NPT. Four source-basis flags exist: three CBS day bases longer than their DDR day count, producing negative calendar deltas, and one missing CBS day basis. These are source-basis flags, not recalculated costs. The 50/50 waiting fallback was removed from the pipeline.
findings.action: Use an_cost_track_audit and an_npt_attribution_audit as the financial close-out register; investigate the four CBS day-basis flags with Contracts before any final invoice settlement.
